segments: Over a beige background, red string bunches together to spell out the title card "Heartstrings" in cursive.
Two creatures made out of beige string stand side by side against the beige background. The taller one on the right looks down and then sneaks a glance at the left one, who glances over too.
A bit of red string pops out of the chest area of the taller creature, who inspects it and continues glancing at the shorter creature.
The taller creature steps toward the shorter one. The shorter one looks up and the taller one freezes, and then starts moving closer again when the shorter one looks away.
The taller one holds the end of the red string in its hand, appearing to making a shape with it. The shorter creature looks over at what's happening.
The taller one shows the heart shape it created with the string to the shorter one. The shorter one laughs.
A bit of red string pops out of the shorter one's chest area, and it reaches to pull the string out more.
Both creatures' red strings suddenly connect with each other, pulling them together. They hold hands.
The red string wraps around both their bodies as they continue holding hands. They touch their faces to each other.
The screen fades away to the beige background.

The scenes fades back in, showing the the shorter one laying in the lap of the taller one and both looking into each others' eyes. The red string, on the ground, surrounds them. The screen cuts to black.
